rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a day-5 expanded blastocyst and appropriately cautious about limits of a single image, but it appears to misstate the lab grade details by calling TE moderate/B when the provided Gardner 3AB indicates ICM A and TE B, and some image-specific features are described somewhat generically.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, semen parameters, BMI, prior cycle history, and especially thin endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with the implantation estimate tied to embryo quality and uterine factors; minor issue is some ambiguity around morphology interpretation versus the stated Gardner grade.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including caution about thin lining and avoiding unsupported add-ons; minor speculative elements remain around some adjunct evaluations.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including lining reassessment, luteal support review, and consideration of freeze-all/FET strategies, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
